# Vara v0.7.0 — the rework after the tag

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-release-notes.mjs from v0.7.0..HEAD — do not hand-edit the blocks below. -->

15 plugins ship with this release, read from `plugins/` at the time of
writing. Everything dangerous — vara.browser.use, vara.channels, vara.computer.use, vara.mcp.client, vara.swarm.team, vara.tools.write — is **present and off**.

## What changed

*Read from `git log v0.7.0..HEAD` — 19 commits, none of them written here by hand.*


### Security

- fix(security): the fetch path can no longer reach the machine's own network (`9fe9fee`)
- fix(security): confinement now proves itself on the filesystem, not just in text (`015a8e8`)
- fix(security): the hard-deny floor now covers commands, not only tools (`0ee4683`)

### Honesty and evidence

- docs(matrix): record what could not be verified here, including the WebView2 blocker (`7a5a3e0`)
- docs(matrix): the matrix now reports what is fixed, and keeps what is not (`bdfc4e5`)
- feat(ui): render the gate receipt, so a PASS can no longer appear alone (`753e13f`)
- fix(provenance): C1 now means *fetched*, and a never-fetched citation is named (`4feb724`)
- fix(honesty): the verdict decides the outcome, split frames survive, and plugins ship (`0794ce4`)

### Durability and lifecycle

- fix(initiative): the heartbeat latch means "alive", not "started once" (`64e5014`)
- fix(durability): zombie missions are reconciled at startup (`7274874`)

### Composition and plugins

- fix(ci): drop --workspace from the Linux test step, which cannot build GTK (`82415a5`)
- fix(ci): lint and test where each crate can actually build (`04c728f`)
- feat(shell): the plugin host runs in production, not only in tests (`35082d1`)
- feat(seams): the mission event stream now really comes from a plugin (`0c5d96e`)
- fix(shell): render the refusal through ToolError::message, which is the shape the model reads (`db95357`)

### Repository and tooling

- fix(ci): the hard clippy gate now passes, because the code was fixed rather than the gate (`19e57b6`)
- docs: synchronise every document with the product, and add the missing index (`cc8eedd`)
- chore(clippy): 47 warnings to 2, and one of them was a real defect (`0d8e49e`)

### Other

- fix(tools): system_info now reports real memory, because nothing filled the field (`53185e7`)

## What this release does *not* claim

See [`docs/REALITY_MATRIX.md`](docs/REALITY_MATRIX.md) for every product claim with the
command that proves it, and [`docs/PLUGIN_INVENTORY.md`](docs/PLUGIN_INVENTORY.md) for the
generated plugin list. Where this document and the repository disagree, the
repository is right and this document is a bug — the previous release proved that
the hard way.
